notes: What the engine needs from the game-clock component. Two clocks: action (moves, automatic steps, result pauses, rebuy offers) and level (blind or other level progression). advance is called with which clocks run since the last update; the engine decides that from pause, holds and open rebuy offers (presence and tournament). Wall times are epoch milliseconds. runs.level is false while rebuy offers are open (tournament.levelClockRuns); runs.action is false while the table is paused or held. Neither flag changes the other clock.

advance.returns: ClockState (adds now minus the last update to each clock that runs; never goes backwards)

wallAt.returns: number (epoch ms at which that clock reaches targetMs if it keeps running from the last update; never before the last update)
